story_type: helicopter hovers beside the Queen Mary 2 at sea, swimmer lowered down the hull, litter hoist
hook: A helicopter pressed against the side of the Queen Mary 2.
narration: This helicopter hovered right beside the Queen Mary 2, seventy miles out to sea.
An eighty-four-year-old passenger had fallen on board and was badly hurt.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew lowered their rescue swimmer down the cable, a few feet from the ship's side.
The flight mechanic runs the hoist and guides the pilot, who cannot see below.
On deck, the swimmer got her into a rescue litter.
Then the litter came up the cable, over the ship's deck.
outcome: And the Jayhawk crew hoisted her up off the deck of the Queen Mary 2.
title: Hoisted off the Queen Mary 2 at sea
description:
On July 2, 2018, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted an injured 84-year-old woman from the deck of the cruise ship Queen Mary 2, 70 miles southeast of Nantucket, Massachusetts.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Coast Guard Northeast, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/611572/coast-guard-medevacs-injured-cruise-ship-passenger-70-miles-southeast-nantucket
